💬 Real Talk Expressions
📌 "Actually"

Used to introduce an opposing idea or a surprising fact.
تُستخدم للتعبير عن فكرة مغايرة أو مفاجئة

Example

Agent: "How about India?"
Omar: "Actually, I want a place that isn't full of tourists."

📌 "Off the beaten track"

A place not visited by many tourists — remote, unusual.
مكان بعيد عن السياح / غير مشهور

Example

Omar: "I want somewhere off the beaten track."

💬 Activity 6 – Conversation | Page 106
🎙️
Conversation · Track 3-24
Omar at the Travel Agency
0:00--:--
📖 It's Going to Be Fun!
Agent
What kind of vacation are you looking for?
Omar
I'm looking for a vacation in an exotic and exciting place. I love to meet people and learn about new cultures.
Agent
How about India?
Omar
It's a bit too crowded, and Indian food is not my favorite food.
Agent
Do you like nature? We have ecological tours in the Costa Rican rainforest. You can stay in a treetop resort. It's a unique jungle experience. You're going to love it.
Omar
I'm allergic to mosquitoes.
Agent
Why don't you go to the Alps? You will experience French, Swiss, Italian, and German cultures.
Omar
Actually, I want a place that isn't full of tourists. Somewhere off the beaten track.
🗣️ Real Talk

Actually = opposing idea  ·  off the beaten track = not visited by many tourists

📝 About the Conversation
It's a bit too crowded, and Indian food is not his favorite food.
He is allergic to mosquitoes.
A place that isn't full of tourists — somewhere off the beaten track.

🏆 Challenge Question

🌍 Think & Write

Imagine you are a travel agent. A student says:

"I want an exciting vacation. I love nature and animals. I don't like crowded places."

Suggest TWO destinations and explain why. Use "You're going to love it!" and "off the beaten track" in your answer.

Sample Answer:
"How about the Amazon Rainforest in Brazil? You can see wild animals and explore nature. It's off the beaten track — you're going to love it!
Or, what about Namibia in Africa? Lions, elephants, stunning landscapes — and it's definitely not crowded!"
